name: Hive 1.18.0
notes: Features: subscription CLI runtimes for Antigravity CLI (Google AI Pro/Ultra) and GitHub Copilot CLI, detected in Settings with one-click Add runtime; agent-authored workflows filed as reviewable proposals, with a read-only Workflows pane; new docs pages for the phone app, remote access, the serve box, the dashboard and what's new. Changes: the visual workflow editor is removed. Fixes: hive worker accepts keyless Claude Code and Codex runtimes.
